text:
jess: Quick question — onboarding folks keep tripping over different SDK error shapes. Can we agree on a small, typed surface (RateLimitError / AuthError / PermissionError / ServerError) plus a machine-readable retry hint? Hitting parity issues between python/ts/go in the sample app. ping @sanjay for go parity :)

sanjay: We have a rough draft in sample-apps. Main pain points: 1) 429 sometimes comes with Retry-After header (seconds or HTTP-date), 2) 5xxs mix transient vs permanent, 3) auth errors where token refresh is automatic vs fatal. Example payload we see from infra: ```
{
  "type": "rate_limit",
  "status": 429,
  "message": "Requests per minute exceeded",
  "headers": { "retry-after": "3" }
}```

jess: Nice. I'd like SDKs to surface that as RateLimitError(retry_after_seconds: Optional[int], raw_message: str) with a standardized retry_hint enum like "no-retry"/"retry-after"/"exponential". That way UI and sample apps can decide backoff.

maria: Agree on enum. For auth: 401 -> AuthError (retry_hint: "refresh-token" if token-based), 403 -> PermissionError (no retry). Also propose a small status mapping doc: `401 -> AuthError`, `403 -> PermissionError`, `429 -> RateLimitError`, `5xx -> ServerError (transient)`, `4xx-other -> ClientError (no-retry)`. We should surface underlying HTTP status and original headers in the exception for debugging.

kevin: FYI python/ts already have typed classes; go currently returns *APIError with fields only. Fix proposal for go: export specific error types and add helper `IsRetryable(err error) bool` and `RetryAfter(err error) time.Duration`. Also handle parsing `Retry-After: Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT` and numeric strings.

ci-bot: build/go-sdk master failed: tests/errors_parity_test.go:42 -> expected RateLimitError but got APIError. https://ci.internal/redwood/go-sdk/1223 (logs attached) :pray:

sanjay: I'll queue a small PR to: 1) add typed error structs (RateLimitError, AuthError), 2) parse Retry-After into seconds and set RetryHint="retry-after", 3) include `Retryable()` method. Will add a tiny sample in sample-apps showing backoff using `err.RetryAfter()` and `err.RetryHint()`.

jess: Love it. Could we also standardize the JSON error envelope from the platform for new models? Maybe: `{ code, message, http_status, retry_hint, metadata }` so SDKs just map fields.

maria: +1. Let's keep human message short and a machine field `retry_hint` with values: `no-retry`, `retry-after`, `exponential`, `refresh-token`. That covers most cases.

kevin: I'll own the go PR review. sanjay can you drop the PR link here when ready? Also add a test that simulates `Retry-After: Mon, 02 Jan 2023 15:04:05 GMT`.

jess: Putting this on the devex board as `sdk-errors: unify typed errors + retry_hint` and adding sample-app checklist. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

sanjay: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/go-sdk/pulls/456 — implements RateLimitError + RetryAfter parsing. Tests updated.

ci-bot: merge pipeline started for PR 456.

maria: Super. After merge let's update docs/snippets in onboarding to use `except RateLimitError as e:` and show reading `e.retry_after`. Small change, big DX win. :rocket:
